# Glosser notes — cid-tiradas-144-149a

PyMuPDF could not be installed (no network), so Pidal's footnotes were not consulted; all entries rest on the text and general knowledge.

Unsure:
- apareçidos / fuessen (v. 3355): "would that these marriages had not come about"; sense of apareçidos uncertain.
- consagrar (v. 3356): "consecrate, make binding"; the sense "ally by marriage" is from context.
- rogador (v. 3395): "suitor, one who asks / envoy"; Pidal's restored word, sense uncertain.
- éstot (v. 3344): esto + te as ethic dative, "this I shall fight out with you".
- telo (v. 3389): fazer + te + lo with split future [he].
- Ovirna: river Ubierna near Burgos, identification from general knowledge, not from Pidal's note.
- Ojarra / Yéñego Simenones: names given as Pidal prints them; the modern forms (Íñigo Jiménez) are equivalents.
- picar los molinos: "to dress millstones", from general knowledge.
- cuerpo in riébtot el cuerpo: "in person" is a reading from context.
- Broadened: di (imperative of decir), otorga (imperative), o (por o), menos, malo, cuerpo, viene, quanto, fo + inf., partir, recabdo, qual, es de, ca yo non.
